Method of Attack: Embedding hidden cryptocurrency miner scripts in JavaScript files
Impacted Systems: Websites using Cookie Consent popup scripts
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious JavaScript files via third-party Cookie Consent service
Loading compromised JavaScript files from cookiescript.info and cookiescript.cdn2.info domains
Use of WordPress plugin deploying infected scripts
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of Crypto-Loot miner code in cookie consent JavaScript files
